name: Game Downloads
author: David JM
description: Live Steam, Heroic and native Epic Games Launcher download progress in the Omarchy bar, read from each launcher's own local state.

barWidget.description: Shows in-flight downloads from Steam, Heroic (Epic, GOG and Amazon games) and the native Epic Games Launcher. The pill appears only while something is downloading; click it for per-game detail and source, or open the relevant launcher.

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read the launchers' download state. Steam and Epic rates are derived from growth between two polls; Heroic reports its own rate. Shorter intervals make speed and ETA steadier at the cost of more disk reads.

schema.label: Show queued downloads
schema.description: Include games a launcher has accepted but not started downloading. They are listed in the popup only, and never count as active downloads.

schema.label: Desktop download notifications
schema.description: Notify when a download finishes, stops, or its launcher closes mid-download. Clicking the notification opens the relevant launcher. Heroic already sends its own notifications, so disable this if you prefer its native ones.

schema.label: Keep the screen awake while downloading
schema.description: Ask the Media Idle Inhibit plugin for a sleep lease while any monitored download is active. The lease is released as soon as the last download stops.
